items.title: Why Workday (WDAY) Shares Are Sliding Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise software company Workday (NASDAQ:WDAY) fell 2.5% in the morning session after two Wall Street firms issued bearish calls, highlighted by Morgan Stanley downgrading the stock from Equal Weight to Underweight. The firm slashed its price target from $185 to $145. Analysts argued that the pace of AI-driven growth would be gradual, creating an uncertain growth and margin outlook.
